definitions.explanation: A government-granted exclusive right to an invention, preventing others from making, using, or selling it without permission. Also refers to the patent document itself.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{特許|とっきょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}っている→取る：00565_toru⟧。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{発明|はつめい}→発明：01495_hatsumei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{特許|とっきょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}した→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧。
examples.english: I applied for a patent on the new invention.

examples.japanese: {特許|とっきょ}⟦{侵害|しんがい}→侵害：11563_shingai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{訴|うった}えられた→訴える：01891_uttaeru⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{和解金|わかいきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支払|しはら}った→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧。
examples.english: The company that was sued for patent infringement paid a settlement.

notes:
USAGE:
A legal and business term, but widely known in everyday Japanese. {特許|とっきょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to obtain a patent) and {特許|とっきょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}する→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧ (to apply for a patent) are the most common verb combinations. Japan's patent office is the {特許庁|とっきょちょう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {特許|とっきょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to obtain a patent
- {特許|とっきょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}する→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧: to apply for a patent
- {特許|とっきょ}⟦{侵害|しんがい}→侵害：11563_shingai⟧: patent infringement
- {特許|とっきょ}{権|けん}: patent right
- {特許庁|とっきょちょう}: Patent Office
